hints.title: Non-Adjacent Box Merging Payoff
hints.text: Removing consecutive identical boxes awards the square of their count. Often clearing intervening boxes first allows distant identical boxes to merge into a much higher scoring cluster.

hints.title: Augmented State with Contiguous Suffix
hints.text: A simple range [i, j] cannot predict incoming matching boxes. Track (i, j, k) where k is the number of boxes preceding or following that share the same color.

hints.title: Dual Option Recursive Evaluation Procedure
hints.text: Compress contiguous identical boxes at the boundary. Option one: eliminate the current block of size k + 1 for (k + 1)^2 points and solve the remaining interval. Option two: find any matching box m inside the interval and clear intermediate elements first to combine both segments. Memoize results for state tuple (l, r, k).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input size or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N^4) time and O(N^3) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy choice fails because deferring a removal to accumulate a larger clump can score exponentially higher.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 3D state (l, r, k) requires O(n^3) space and runs in O(n^4) time with memoization.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize why standard 2D interval DP is insufficient and augment the state with a trailing identical box count.
